c-member-bookmarks.1.evidence: bob opened 'Dark mode for the community on phones' and clicked the bookmark icon: aria-label Bookmark -> Remove bookmark, aria-pressed true, icon filled, toast 'Bookmarked'.

c-member-bookmarks.2.evidence: /community/bookmarks/ lists the topic with title, 'Open' badge, author Sofia Romano, space Feature Requests, reply count 51, age and a filled bookmark button.

c-member-bookmarks.3.evidence: With 2 bookmarks, clicking the filled bookmark on a row removed that row at once (rows 2 -> 1) and REST total fell 2 -> 1. The page prints no separate bookmark count; the count is the list/REST total.

c-member-bookmarks.4.evidence: Set window.__marker, removed the last bookmark: the 'You haven't bookmarked anything yet.' empty state appeared immediately and the marker survived (no reload); clicking the Leaderboard tab then did a full page load (marker gone) showing the complete Top members list.

c-member-bookmarks.5.evidence: REST as bob: POST {post_id 17722} -> 200 {bookmarked:true}; POST again -> {bookmarked:false}; POST -> true; DELETE /bookmarks/17722 -> 200 {deleted:true}; repeat DELETE -> 200 {deleted:true}; jt_bookmarks has 0 rows for it, never a duplicate. (The id in the path is the topic id.)

c-member-bookmarks.6.evidence: bob POST /bookmarks for Moderators' Room topic 241 -> 404 jetonomy_not_found 'Topic not found.'

c-member-bookmarks.7.evidence: Logged-out topic page shows no bookmark control; GET /community/bookmarks/ -> 302 to wp-login.php?redirect_to=.../community/bookmarks/; POST /bookmarks -> 401 rest_not_logged_in.

c-member-bookmarks.8.evidence: alice and bob each bookmarked different topics: alice's /community/bookmarks/ and GET /bookmarks (also with user_id=10) return only her own (249); bob's profile shows alice no Bookmarks tab.

c-member-bookmarks.9.evidence: alice created a topic, bob bookmarked it (list 2), admin deleted it -> bob's GET /bookmarks drops to 1 and /community/bookmarks/ shows no broken or 'unavailable' row.

c-member-bookmarks.10.evidence: bob bookmarked Partner Program topic 19774 while admitted only by a role rule (no roster row) and saw it in /bookmarks; removing the rule (access lost) hid it again, total 0. Same hiding happened for his follow when he was removed from the roster.
